name: Dialog
purpose: Modal window over a dimmed page for focused tasks or confirmations.

parts.name: overlay
parts.description: Full-viewport scrim, 50% black, above all content.

parts.name: panel
parts.description: Card fill, 1px border, extra-large shadow; column layout.

parts.name: header
parts.description: Row with a 20px foreground title on the left and a close button (20px X icon, muted-foreground) on the right; 24px horizontal padding, 24px top and 16px bottom, 1px bottom border.

parts.name: body
parts.description: Scrollable area, 24px horizontal and 20px vertical padding, 14px muted-foreground text.

parts.name: footer
parts.description: Right-aligned row of actions with 12px gap, 24px by 16px padding, 1px top border.

variants.name: size
variants.description: Maximum panel width on wide screens: md is 28rem, xl is 42rem.

layout: Centered on wide screens with 16px outer margin and max height of viewport minus 32px; rounded large corners.
responsive: Below the small breakpoint (640px) the panel fills the whole viewport with no radius and no margin; from 640px up it is centered.
constraints: Focus is trapped inside while open and returns to the trigger on close.
accessibility: Dialog role named by its title.
Close button must be reachable and labelled.

name: Tooltip
purpose: Short label shown when a trigger is hovered or focused.

parts.name: bubble
parts.description: 14px text, 12px by 8px padding, popover fill, 1px border, large radius, large shadow; fades and zooms in.

accessibility: Appears on keyboard focus as well as hover; describes the trigger.

name: Accordion
purpose: A single collapsible section with a heading trigger.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Full-width row, 16px horizontal and 12px vertical padding, card fill; title on the left in 14px medium-weight foreground text with an optional badge beside it, and a 16px chevron on the right that rotates 180 degrees when open.

parts.name: panel
parts.description: Content area with card fill, shown only when open.

layout: Stack of trigger then panel; multiple Accordions are stacked by the consumer.
constraints: Title is wrapped in a heading element.
accessibility: Trigger exposes expanded state and controls the panel; Enter and Space toggle.

name: ProgressBar
purpose: Shows completion of a task as a horizontal bar.

parts.name: header
parts.description: Row with label (14px foreground) left and value text (14px muted-foreground) right.

parts.name: track
parts.description: Full-width 8px tall fully rounded bar, secondary fill, clipped.

parts.name: fill
parts.description: Accent bar sized to the percentage; width animates over 300ms.

accessibility: Progress bar role with current, minimum, maximum and readable value text; needs a label.

name: OrderStatusTimeline
purpose: Shows an order moving through three stages, or a cancelled badge.

parts.name: step
parts.description: Column with a 28px circle (12px bold number, or a check mark when complete) above a 12px centered, non-wrapping label.

parts.name: connector
parts.description: 2px tall line between consecutive steps filling the space; top-aligned to the circle's vertical center.

parts.name: cancelled badge
parts.description: Replaces the timeline: inline pill, 12px horizontal and 6px vertical padding, large radius, 14px medium text, an X glyph then the word Cancelled.

variants.name: status
variants.description: Steps are labelled In Queue, Printing, Done. waiting activates step 1; in_progress marks step 1 done and activates step 2; complete marks all three done; cancelled shows only the badge.

states: step complete (green fill, white check, green medium-weight label)
step active (orange fill, white number, orange medium-weight label)
step pending (secondary fill, 1px border, muted-foreground number and label)
layout: Horizontal row; steps are evenly separated by flexible connectors.
constraints: No color prop; colors are fixed by status.
accessibility: Container labelled with the current status.
Active step marked as the current step.
